claim_results.claim: The paper uses a controlled synthetic reasoning framework with explicit dependency graphs, contextual templates, and process-verified evaluation (Figure 2).
claim_results.limitation: This is a source and dataset audit, not a rerun of full language-model training.
claim_results.observation: Pinned source exposes dependency graph, contextual dataset, process reward, and evaluation code paths; sampled datasets expose composition and context splits.

claim_results.claim: RL yields extrapolative pass@128 gains only when the post-training tasks sit near the model's edge of competence; gains vanish when tasks are already covered or too far out-of-distribution (Figure 1; Figure 3).
claim_results.limitation: No raw official result artifact was found; paper-reported numeric gains are not treated as reproduced measurements.
claim_results.observation: Pinned artifacts expose the experiment family and lightweight provenance needed for a structural audit.

claim_results.claim: Contextual generalization requires minimal but nonzero pre-training exposure to long-tail contexts; exposure of at least about 1% enables RL to reinforce transfer (Figure 1; Figure 4).
claim_results.limitation: No raw official result artifact was found; paper-reported numeric gains are not treated as reproduced measurements.
claim_results.observation: Pinned artifacts expose the experiment family and lightweight provenance needed for a structural audit.

claim_results.claim: Mid-training plus RL outperforms RL alone on OOD-hard reasoning under fixed compute, with reported +10.8% gains (Figure 1; Figure 6).
claim_results.limitation: No raw official result artifact was found; paper-reported numeric gains are not treated as reproduced measurements.
claim_results.observation: Pinned artifacts expose the experiment family and lightweight provenance needed for a structural audit.

claim_results.claim: Process-aware reward compositions reduce shortcut exploitation and improve reasoning performance relative to pure outcome rewards (Figure 7).
claim_results.limitation: No raw official result artifact was found; paper-reported numeric gains are not treated as reproduced measurements.
claim_results.observation: Pinned artifacts expose the experiment family and lightweight provenance needed for a structural audit.

claim_results.claim: Training dynamics show reward stagnates when RL data are too easy or too hard, but improves when tasks are calibrated to the edge of competence (Figure 11).

title: On the Interplay of Pre-Training, Mid-Training, and RL on Reasoning Language Models
